releases.name: Slow-powers v0.7.0
releases.body:
<!-- release-notes -->
## Release notes

### Highlights

- Add [`writing-technical-docs`](https://github.com/slowdini/slow-powers/pull/274), a cross-harness skill that scales an audience → gather → structure → draft → review process from one-line comments to long-form documentation. Its companion references cover document conventions, technical formatting, and durable prose, with evals that guard against over-ceremony on small docs.
- Expand [`evaluating-skills`](https://github.com/slowdini/slow-powers/pull/277) with guidance to provide real inspectable state for action-based cases, preserve realistic shared context in both comparison arms, and smoke-test mechanical graders against real output before scaling a run.

### Behavior changes to know about

- Rename `slow-powers:test-driven-development` to [`slow-powers:working-with-tdd`](https://github.com/slowdini/slow-powers/pull/276). Update direct invocations and skill dependencies; the previous skill name is no longer shipped.
- Keep [Cline Memory Bank contents](https://github.com/slowdini/slow-powers/pull/272) as per-developer local state. The `memory-bank/` directory is Git-ignored while the shared `.clinerules/` instructions remain tracked.

### Fixes

- [Skills-reference validation badge updates](https://github.com/slowdini/slow-powers/pull/279) no longer fail when pushing to protected `dev`; the workflow checks out using the release token required by branch protection.

### Internal changes

- Give [release PRs](https://github.com/slowdini/slow-powers/pull/278) a tested, sectioned notes skeleton while preserving auto-generated notes as the fallback until the placeholder marker is removed.
